# Municipal Ordinance No. 06, Series of 2002

**Ordinance implementing RA 8172, the ASIN Law, in Pitogo, Quezon**

## Summary

This ordinance mandates the sale of iodized salt in retail and wholesale outlets within Pitogo, Quezon. It also requires conducting salt testing activities in groceries, sari-sari stores, and talipapa. The ordinance designates the Barangay Health Worker as the Asin Coordinator and outlines penalties for selling non-iodized salt.

## Key Provisions

1.  It is mandated by law to sell iodized salt in any retail or wholesale outlet in the municipality of Pitogo, Quezon.
2.  It is mandated by law to conduct salt testing activity in all groceries, sari-sari stores and talipapa in the presence of the Mun. Mayor, Vice-Mayor, SB for Health, ABC President, Municipal Health Officer in the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon
3.  The Barangay Health Workers (BHW) as Patak as Asin Coordinator, Sanitary Inspectors, Market Inspector and Rural Health Midwives shall be the implementors of this ordinance.
4.  The Municipal Health Office shall provide all necessary equipment or gadget for the testing of salt to determined if it is iodized salt.
5.  All vendors, retailers and wholesalers caught selling no iodized salt shall be warned of the penalty provisions of the Asin Law for the 1st offense and shall be fined in the amount of -P- 500.00 and not more than -P- 1,000.00 for the second and succeeding offenses.
6.  Any ordinance or part thereof which it inconsistent with the provision of this ordinance is hereby repealed.
7.  This ordinance shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
8.  Approved by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon this 9th day of December, 2002.
